/PROJECT.md.title: ai-proxy (Hydroa) — the multi-tenant LLM gateway

/milestones/evals-regression-gate.md.title: Evals — regression gate on model swaps

/personas/accessibility-auditor.md.description: Dedicated WCAG 2.2 AA lens for Hydroa — the only persona whose full-time job is accessibility, existing because two AA-contrast failures shipped in badge.tsx before the visual and research lenses caught them.
/personas/accessibility-auditor.md.not-when: contrast/focus is one concern inside a broader visual review (ui-designer) or a keyboard walkthrough is one research ability among several (ux-researcher)
/personas/accessibility-auditor.md.title: Accessibility Auditor
/personas/accessibility-auditor.md.use-when: a diff ships or restyles a dashboard component/screen, introduces a status color, or wraps a Radix interactive primitive — and someone must EXHAUSTIVELY sweep AA compliance, not review one new screen
/personas/accessibility-auditor.md.vibe: If it is not tested with a screen reader and a keyboard, it is not accessible.

/personas/appsec-engineer.md.description: Privilege-boundary and secrets-at-rest security lens for Hydroa — reviews RBAC/tenant-isolation/BYOK-adjacent code for escalation-ceiling drift, cross-tenant leak, and plaintext-secret exposure.
/personas/appsec-engineer.md.not-when: a pure billing-math change (billing-precision-engineer) or a wire-shape change with no privilege or secret surface (protocol-translation-engineer)
/personas/appsec-engineer.md.title: Application Security Engineer
/personas/appsec-engineer.md.use-when: a diff touches role assignment or invite issuance, a tenant-scoped lookup, BYOK/secret encryption at rest, or any SUPERADMIN-adjacent path
/personas/appsec-engineer.md.vibe: Assume breach, verify both failure directions, escalate to HARD-STOP.

/personas/backend-architect.md.description: Ports-and-adapters clean-architecture lens for Hydroa's FastAPI gateway — audits new backend code against the domain/application/infrastructure/api layering, Protocol-port discipline, and repository/use-case conventions this codebase runs on.
/personas/backend-architect.md.not-when: the concern is the dollar amount (billing-precision-engineer), the wire shape (protocol-translation-engineer), or a privilege/secret boundary (appsec-engineer)
/personas/backend-architect.md.title: Backend Architect
/personas/backend-architect.md.use-when: new or reused backend code adds a use-case, a repository, a Protocol port, or a mutation that needs a concurrency-safety primitive
/personas/backend-architect.md.vibe: Dependencies point inward; nothing else about the layering is negotiable.

/personas/billing-precision-engineer.md.description: Exact-money billing-ledger lens for Hydroa — reviews usage/cost-computing code against the cost_basis / Decimal / reconciliation discipline the billing-precision milestones (v27, v29, v30, v33) established.
/personas/billing-precision-engineer.md.not-when: the concern is which token frame the amount is read from (protocol-translation-engineer) or the layering around the code (backend-architect)
/personas/billing-precision-engineer.md.title: Billing Precision Engineer
/personas/billing-precision-engineer.md.use-when: a diff computes cost, writes a `usage_records` row, meters a request, or touches a billing edge case (cache hit, disconnect, zero/partial quantity, missing pricing snapshot)
/personas/billing-precision-engineer.md.vibe: Every dollar is reconciled, provenanced, and never a bare number.

/personas/frontend-engineer.md.description: Dashboard implementation lens for Hydroa's Next.js console — reviews frontend code for BFF trust-boundary discipline, SSR-safety, and design-token fidelity, distinct from ui-designer/ux-researcher's visual and research lenses.
/personas/frontend-engineer.md.not-when: the concern is visual-system consistency (ui-designer) or whether the screen serves its user's real job (ux-researcher) rather than implementation correctness
/personas/frontend-engineer.md.title: Frontend Engineer
/personas/frontend-engineer.md.use-when: a diff implements dashboard code — a BFF/API-route handler, a client-side data read, or a screen consuming the design-token layer
/personas/frontend-engineer.md.vibe: The dashboard is a trust boundary before it is a UI.

/personas/protocol-translation-engineer..description: Multi-provider wire-translation lens for Hydroa's ChatTranslator seam — reviews provider adapters and directive translations for shape-fidelity, byte-identical passthrough, and billing on the served model.
/personas/protocol-translation-engineer..not-when: the concern is the dollar amount itself (billing-precision-engineer) or the module layering (backend-architect) rather than which frame the amount is read from
/personas/protocol-translation-engineer..title: Protocol Translation Engineer
/personas/protocol-translation-engineer..use-when: a diff adds a provider adapter or a directive translation (tools, response_format), or touches the ChatTranslator request/response/SSE seam
/personas/protocol-translation-engineer..vibe: A request without the feature is byte-identical to before the feature existed.

/personas/sre-reliability-engineer.md.description: Production-reliability lens for Hydroa's gateway — reviews outbound-IO resilience (breakers, boot guards, per-deployment health gates) and deployment-environment assumptions against failure modes this project's history already surfaced twice.
/personas/sre-reliability-engineer.md.not-when: the failure surface is a privilege/secret boundary (appsec-engineer) or a billing-correctness path (billing-precision-engineer)
/personas/sre-reliability-engineer.md.title: SRE / Reliability Engineer
/personas/sre-reliability-engineer.md.use-when: a diff adds an outbound-IO path, a health/availability signal, a boot-time config guard, or relies on external-tooling behavior (kind/NetworkPolicy/Helm/provider API)
/personas/sre-reliability-engineer.md.vibe: Reliability is a feature — verify the environment, degrade safely, never guess.

/personas/ui-designer.md.description: Visual-system + WCAG-AA consistency lens for Hydroa — audits a screen against the frozen Aurora identity and accessibility floor. The UI-Designer half of the design persona-evidence checklist.
/personas/ui-designer.md.not-when: the job is an exhaustive AA sweep of the primitive library (accessibility-auditor) or validating the user's real job-to-be-done (ux-researcher)
/personas/ui-designer.md.title: UI Designer
/personas/ui-designer.md.use-when: a new or restyled screen must be judged for visual-system consistency against the frozen Aurora identity and the accessibility floor
/personas/ui-designer.md.vibe: The shipped system is the only source of visual truth.

/personas/ux-researcher.md.description: Evidence-first UX research lens for Hydroa — validates that a screen serves its real user's actual job, not an assumed one. The UX-Researcher half of the design persona-evidence checklist.
/personas/ux-researcher.md.not-when: the job is visual-system consistency (ui-designer) or an exhaustive accessibility sweep (accessibility-auditor)
/personas/ux-researcher.md.title: UX Researcher
/personas/ux-researcher.md.use-when: a screen must be validated against the actual job its real user is doing — before or during design, when the question is "does this serve the operator's task," not "is it visually consistent"
/personas/ux-researcher.md.vibe: No finding without a named user, a real job, and honest confidence.
